source.asset: Chess Set by Riley Queen, Poly Haven, CC0

units: exported OBJ/STL are in metres; all numbers in this manifest are mm unless suffixed _m

method.recentre: x,y: centroid of the vertices in the bottom 1.5 mm; z_min = 0
method.height: z extent; z scale = target_height / source height
method.foot: vertices in the bottom 20 % of the height
method.foot_diameter: widest point of the foot: maximum pairwise x-y distance of the foot vertices (= maximum caliper width over all directions)
method.xy_scale: target_base_diameter / foot_diameter, with the foot diameter measured on the z-scaled piece
method.checks: (a) exported foot diameter within 0.2 mm of the target, (b) max x-y width of everything above the foot <= foot diameter (+0.01 mm), (c) height within 0.2 mm

allowed_exceptions_to_check_b.knight: the knight's head overhangs its base front-to-back in the source geometry (45.4 mm head vs 39.1 mm base); scaling the foot to the target keeps that ratio

method.base_diameter_bottom_1p5mm: reference only: max of x/y extent of the vertices in the bottom 1.5 mm
method.diameter_profile: max x-y extent (and max pairwise x-y distance) of vertices in 10 equal-height bands, bottom to top
method.stem: x-y extent of the exact planar cross-section (trimesh mesh_plane) every 1 % of height between 45 % and 75 %; 'stem_diameter_at_62pct' is the 62 % cut, 'stem_min_45_75pct' the narrowest cut
method.convex_hull: MuJoCo qhull via a vertex= point-cloud mesh; verified closed and containing all vertices
method.knight_facing: direction of the centroid of vertices in the top 40 % of the height relative to the base centroid

z_rotation.note: rotation about +z applied after scaling; afterwards the top-40% centroid / muzzle lie on +x

above_foot_not_wider.reason: the knight's head overhangs its base front-to-back in the source geometry (45.4 mm head vs 39.1 mm base); scaling the foot to the target keeps that ratio

warnings: geometry above the foot is wider than the foot by 2.72 mm (19.72 vs 17.00 mm) [allowed exception]
